title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with ordered boundary-sized binary XDATA chunks

scope.source: Runtime-generated LTYPE and APPID records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

authority.relevant_rule: XDATA group 1004 carries binary data in chunks of at most 127 bytes; ASCII DXF represents those bytes as hexadecimal digits. This receipt tests a full-sized chunk followed by a one-byte chunk.

proof.source: Physical runtime-generated source fields and fresh import verify the exact APPID followed by the ordered 127-byte and one-byte chunks. Import-time origin, raw/typed equality, the AppIdName role and APPID name lookup bind the provider.
proof.output: For all four ASCII/binary source/output combinations, the staged output proof checks exact 1001/1004 order and hex bytes; fresh typed readback verifies both chunk boundaries and values.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the source APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter.

limits: The selected LTYPE XDATA admission rejects any individual code-1004 chunk larger than 127 bytes. The receipt does not qualify all chunk counts, empty chunks, alternative chunk values/orderings, or every aggregate payload boundary.
Other XDATA types, values, payload compositions, APPID counts/metadata, dependency roles, LTYPE schemas and versions remain unqualified.
This receipt establishes transport only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE provider support.
